# Summary

Describe the task, motivation, affected skills, and compatibility impact.
For a new skill, explain its triggers, non-goals, and overlap with existing work.

## Checklist

- [ ] Read AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and the relevant standards documents.
- [ ] Scoped changes; preserved unrelated work and included no local config.
- [ ] Followed naming, frontmatter, layout, and instruction requirements.
- [ ] Declared dependencies, side effects, permissions, and portability honestly.
- [ ] Reviewed bundled code, paths, untrusted inputs, and secrets/privacy risks.
- [ ] Preserved licenses and recorded provenance for imported material.
- [ ] Added or updated TESTING.md with actual evidence and not-run cases.
- [ ] Ran repository checks and appropriate skill-specific checks.
- [ ] Reviewed the complete diff, including generated and binary files.

Mark non-applicable items explicitly and explain why rather than claiming a pass.

## Verification

List exact commands, observed outcomes, agent/runtime versions where relevant,
and limitations. CI format checks alone do not establish skill behavior or safety.

## Compatibility and permissions

Identify breaking changes, new tools/services, costs, permission requirements,
installation effects, and any live checks that were explicitly authorized.
